svg.title: From IPv4 bytes to the Internet struct
svg.desc: A 60-byte IPv4 packet drawn 32 bits per row. The Protocol byte 06 becomes payload_protocol Some(Tcp), the source and destination address words become source 192.168.0.104 and destination 192.168.0.1, and the 40 bytes after the 20-byte header become payload.
